title: Cloud capacity can expand while monitoring, recovery, and provider accountability remain incomplete
source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-26-108443 review of cloud-security practices in eight selected systems across four federal agencies
geography: United States federal agencies; Departments of State, Transportation, Veterans Affairs, and Small Business Administration

denominator.unit: selected cloud systems across four federal agencies

full_implementation.value: one agency fully implemented all three practices for two systems, and one agency did so for one system

partial_implementation.value: remaining five systems partially implemented the three key practices

practices.value: continuous monitoring, incident response and recovery, and service-level agreements with measurable/enforceable performance terms

observations.method: GAO selected four agencies, reviewed two cloud systems at each, compared documentation with federal policy and guidance, administered standardized questions, and interviewed officials; systems were rated fully, partially, or not implemented.
observations.uncertainty: The eight systems are a selected sample and system names are withheld for sensitivity; the results are not a prevalence estimate for all federal cloud systems.
observations.subgroup: State, Transportation, Veterans Affairs, and Small Business Administration; two systems per agency.
observations.counterinterpretation: Partial implementation does not mean a breach or service failure occurred, and an agency may have compensating controls not captured by the selected practices.

denominator.unit: selected cloud systems assessed for continuous monitoring and service-level agreements

continuous_monitoring_full.unit: systems with fully performed continuous monitoring

service_level_agreement_full.unit: systems with fully implemented service-level-agreement practice

remaining_sla_gap.unit: systems whose agreements did not consistently define performance metrics, measurement, and enforcement

observations.method: GAO compared system documentation and provider-related deliverables against the selected practices and assessed whether metrics and enforcement mechanisms were defined.
observations.uncertainty: The findings identify control implementation gaps, not actual incident frequency, data loss, user harm, or provider fault.
observations.subgroup: Eight selected systems, with provider oversight and agency contract-management practices assessed together.
observations.counterinterpretation: A contract lacking explicit metrics may still deliver acceptable performance; formal metrics are a control for accountability, not proof of poor service.

denominator.unit: GAO recommendations to State, Veterans Affairs, and Small Business Administration

recommendation_scope.value: continuous monitoring, incident response/recovery, provider coordination, response-time measurement, testing, and enforceable service-level metrics

implementation_status.value: open pending confirmation of agency actions

actual_cloud_outcome.unit: incident, recovery, data integrity, confidentiality, availability, or public-user outcome

observations.method: GAO recommendation-status review tied to the selected-system control assessment.
observations.uncertainty: Open recommendations show unresolved governance work but do not establish that a cybersecurity incident or service interruption occurred.
observations.subgroup: State, Veterans Affairs, and Small Business Administration; Transportation was reviewed but not listed among the 12 recommendations in the product summary.
observations.counterinterpretation: Agencies may implement corrective actions before formal closure; recommendation status is a lagging governance signal.

related_sources.claim: Official full-report version supplies the selected-system practice ratings and recommendation details.

boundary: This record shows a gap between adopting cloud services and having verified monitoring, incident recovery, provider accountability, and enforceable performance controls. It does not establish a breach, outage, data loss, user harm, provider failure, or system-wide federal prevalence.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: Official GAO product page used for the extracted findings; the full report is linked as a related source.
